shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A successful skill shot off the plunge spots one of the nine holes, which is the cheapest hole you will ever get.

shots.name: Volcano
shots.notes: The plastic volcano hides a vertical kicker. Shoot it for holes 1, 6 and 9, to start a mode once the insert lights, and to collect a cheat shot or a jackpot whenever one of those is lit here.

shots.name: Mean Hole
shots.notes: A saucer tucked into a walled-off pocket on the volcano's right. When lit it awards Mystery; it also starts Anything Goes and is where Quickpick gets offered.

shots.name: Top Flipper
shots.notes: Three things sit in range of this little upper flipper: the volcano, the hurry-up standup and the ramp that carries a ball into the Mean Hole. A post alongside it will hold a ball whenever you want to line one up.

shots.name: 20 Million Target
shots.notes: A small standup that pays 20M when lit. A top-flipper shot.

shots.name: Hook Shot Target
shots.notes: One lone standup target. With its insert on you bank the Hook Shot value, and in multiball it can come up lit for a jackpot instead.

shots.name: Centre Lane
shots.notes: A lane feeding a vertical kicker, reachable through a gap in the coconut targets. With every coconut standing it awards a hole in one; with any of them down it spins the Gopher wheel instead.

shots.name: Coconut Drops
shots.notes: Four drop targets guarding the centre lane. Each one adds a million to your end-of-ball bonus, but dropping them also costs you the hole-in-one version of the centre lane shot.

shots.name: Saucer
shots.notes: Plain Gottlieb saucer, nothing exotic about it. Feed it to cover holes 3, 5 and 7, or to take a jackpot when one is lit here.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: The ramp wraps behind the captive ball and hands the ball to your top flipper. Take it for holes 2, 4 and 8, to switch mode start back on at the volcano, and for a jackpot when the insert is lit.

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Runs around to the Mean Hole. Depending on what is lit it pays a Dogleg, a Mystery or a hole in one.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Up in the top right corner sits a ball you cannot drain. Knock it and it clatters around its pen, tripping a bumper and a handful of switches; every hit pads your end-of-ball bonus and pushes the multiball jackpot higher.

shots.name: Slice Target
shots.notes: Each hit spots a letter in SLICE. The full word lights a 50M hurry-up, and this is also where a lit extra ball is collected.

shots.name: Gopher Wheel
shots.notes: Down at the bottom of the playfield a roulette wheel sits recessed into the wood, its twelve pockets carrying the letters of GOPHER. The centre lane spins it any time a coconut is down, and once you have lit every letter, Go-Fore-Par-Tee begins.

shots.name: Left Standup Bank
shots.notes: Three standups on the left with no documented purpose outside Skins Game, where the machine may pick one of them as your double-or-nothing shot.

shots.name: Special Lane
shots.notes: Behind the bank of left standups sits a lane only the top flipper can reach. When the special is lit, this is where you cash it.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Lights Dogleg.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Lights Cheat Shot.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Permanently lit for Hole In One — a drain down here at least buys you a hole.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Also permanently lit for Hole In One.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: A Gottlieb catch-all flipper. Holding it up catches almost anything returning from the volcano or the centre lane, which is the whole basis of this game's scoring strategy.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: The flipper you want to park spare balls on during any multiball so you can keep looping the centre lane.

goals.title: Skill Shot Hole In One
goals.summary: The plunge skill shot spots a hole in one. That is the cheapest hole in the game and it costs you nothing but a careful launch, so take it on every ball.

steps.action: Time the plunge for the skill shot
steps.detail: A successful skill shot off the plunge spots one of the nine holes — the cheapest hole in the game — and counts toward the seven that light an extra ball and the nine that light Quickpick. Trap what comes back on the catch-all flippers rather than swinging blind.

goals.title: Play The Nine Holes
goals.summary: The whole game is a round of golf. Nine holes, hit strictly in numerical order, and three shots spot them: the volcano covers 1, 6 and 9, the right ramp covers 2, 4 and 8, and the saucer covers 3, 5 and 7. Finishing the ninth starts a headline mode.
goals.reward: A multiball or storm mode at the ninth hole

steps.detail: The volcano is the shot you will keep coming back to — it also starts modes when lit.
It feeds the top flipper, which sets up your next shot at the volcano or the Mean Hole.
Only the hole you are actually on gets spotted, so shots at the wrong feature are wasted.

steps.action: Know what the ninth hole gives you
steps.detail: First round is Multiball, second is Raining Cats And Dogs, third is Multiball again, fourth is Anything Goes, then the cycle repeats.

goals.title: Holes In One
goals.summary: A separate counter from the nine holes, and a valuable one. Four ways in: the skill shot, the centre lane with every coconut still standing, a lit Mean Hole, and either outlane — always lit for it. Seven of them awards an extra ball and nine lights Quickpick.
goals.reward: Extra ball at seven, Quickpick at nine

steps.detail: Every coconut has to still be up. Once one is down the same shot only spins the Gopher wheel.

steps.action: Take the Mean Hole when lit
steps.detail: The right orbit feeds around into it, so you have two routes to the same award.
Both outlanes are permanently lit for Hole In One, which is a rare case of a drain paying you something.

goals.title: Quickpick
goals.summary: Nine holes in one lights the Mean Hole for Quickpick, a straight choice between lighting a special and starting a lightning storm. Very few players ever bank nine, which is what makes it worth knowing about.
goals.reward: Light Special, or start a lightning storm
instructions: Holes in one accumulate across the whole game, not per ball, so a bad ball with two outlane drains still moves you forward.
The extra ball lands at seven; keep going and nine lights the Mean Hole for Quickpick.
The offer is two options: light Special, or start a lightning storm.
Take the storm if your ball is stable and you can trap; take the Special if you are on your last ball and struggling.

goals.title: The Five Modes
goals.summary: Five modes, all started at the volcano when it is lit. The first time round it is the volcano itself that relights mode start; after that it is the right ramp. Play all five and the big score target lights, and no more modes can start that ball.
goals.reward: Big score target after all five
instructions: Skins Game — spell SKINS at the volcano, then take ten million or gamble it double-or-nothing on a random shot inside twenty seconds.
Find The Gopher — fifteen seconds to shoot any hole; a lucky one pays thirty million and the rest just insult you.
Extra Ball — the slice target lights for an extra ball for fifteen seconds. Do not miss this one.
Tee'd Off — repeat the centre lane for a value that starts at five million and climbs.
Pitch And Putt — ten million per Mean Hole shot for fifteen seconds, with the lane post available to trap you a clean look.
First time through the modes, the volcano relights itself for mode start. Every time after that, the right ramp does it.

goals.title: Skins Game
goals.summary: Spell SKINS by repeating the volcano, then choose: take ten million and let the machine call you a chicken, or gamble the whole thing on a shot it picks at random with twenty seconds to make it. Miss and your score goes to zero.

steps.detail: Each volcano shot during the mode adds one letter.
The machine picks the shot; the left standup bank is one of the possibilities and does nothing outside this mode.
If you gamble and lose, Recover Score is lit at the Dogleg for the rest of that ball and putting it back is entirely possible.

goals.title: Find The Gopher
goals.summary: Fifteen seconds to shoot any hole on the machine. Find the gopher and you take thirty million; find nothing and the machine has a few things to say about your golf.

steps.action: Take the easiest hole you can reach
steps.detail: Any hole counts, so shoot the one you actually have a line on rather than the one you like.
Fifteen seconds is enough for two shots if you keep the ball under control.

goals.title: Extra Ball Mode
goals.summary: The shortest and most valuable of the five. The slice target lights for an extra ball and you have fifteen seconds. Know where that target is before the mode starts, because you will not have time to go looking.

steps.detail: It is a single standup — one clean shot inside fifteen seconds is all this takes.
Do not swing at a live ball with fifteen seconds on the clock. Catch it, set up, shoot.

goals.title: Tee'd Off
goals.summary: A repeat-shot mode at the centre lane with a value that starts at five million and climbs with each hit. The centre lane returns to your flipper cleanly, which makes this one of the better modes to be caught in.

steps.detail: The gap between the coconut targets is a precise shot, so take the time to trap first.
The catch-all flippers make a genuine loop possible here — this is the same rhythm the big multiball scores are built on.

goals.title: Pitch And Putt
goals.summary: Ten million for every Mean Hole shot, with fifteen seconds on the clock. The post in the lane feeding the top flipper traps the ball so you can line the shot up properly rather than hoping.

steps.action: Get up to the top flipper
steps.detail: The right ramp loops behind the captive ball and feeds it.
The post in the lane holds the ball so you can line up rather than swing at it.
A held ball on the top flipper is the highest-percentage Mean Hole shot on the machine.

goals.title: Mystery
goals.summary: The Mean Hole pays a Mystery award when it is lit. The right orbit can also come around into it with Mystery lit, so you have two angles at the same award without ever going near the top flipper.

steps.action: Take it when the Mystery light is on
steps.detail: The enclosed pocket means a good shot is the only way in.

steps.action: Use the orbit as a back door
steps.detail: The orbit feeds around to the same saucer and can carry a Dogleg, a Mystery or a hole in one depending on what is lit.

goals.title: Spell SLICE
goals.summary: One standup, five letters. Completing SLICE lights a fifty million hurry-up. The same target is where a lit extra ball gets collected, so it is worth learning the angle to it early.

steps.detail: Every hit spots one, and it is a target you will brush past on other shots anyway.
Fifty million falls off from the moment it lights, so know where you are shooting before you complete the word.

goals.title: Multiball
goals.summary: Awarded for the first and third completion of the nine holes. It is two balls unless you launch the second one straight into the Mean Hole, which buys you a third. Strobing jackpots run about five million each and the captive ball pushes them up.

steps.detail: The second ball is served to the plunger. Launch it into the Mean Hole and you get a third ball; miss and you are stuck with two.
Jackpots can be lit at the hook target, the volcano, the saucer and the right ramp among others.
Every captive ball hit pushes the jackpot value up, so bang it a few times before you start cashing.
With only one jackpot left standing, taking it pays a 300M super jackpot and relights all of them for another lap.

goals.title: Raining Cats And Dogs
goals.summary: Your reward for the second round of nine holes. A three-ball lightning storm where every jackpot shot and the centre lane strobe for twenty five million into a running total. The total pays at the end of the ball, so a tilt throws all of it away.
goals.reward: 25M per shot, paid at end of ball

steps.detail: It is included in the strobing shots and is the one you can repeat indefinitely.
Trap the spare balls on the right flipper and play the storm with one — the catch-all flippers make this realistic.
Do not nudge hard. Everything you have banked is lost if you tilt before the ball ends.

goals.title: Anything Goes
goals.summary: The fourth round of nine holes lights the Mean Hole, and shooting it starts the storm again at fifty million a shot. Same rules as Raining Cats And Dogs, double the value, and after this the whole sequence starts over.
goals.reward: 50M per shot, paid at end of ball

steps.detail: Unlike the other storm modes this one does not begin on its own — you have to take the Mean Hole shot.
Fifty million per centre lane shot with two balls parked is where the enormous scores on this machine come from.
Still paid at end of ball, so still no tilting.

goals.title: Go-Fore-Par-Tee
goals.summary: Spell GOPHER on the roulette wheel to start a three-ball multiball where the centre lane and the volcano each pay twenty million on the spot, no conditions attached. The wheel is fed by the centre lane whenever a coconut is down.
goals.reward: 20M per centre lane or volcano shot

steps.detail: With all four standing the centre lane pays a hole in one instead of spinning the wheel, so you have to choose which one you are farming.
With a coconut down, the centre lane feeds a kicker that sets the wheel spinning.
Twelve holes cover the six letters, so some spins land on letters you already have.
Twenty million each, immediately, with no ramp-up and nothing to light first.

goals.title: Feed The Captive Ball
goals.summary: The captive ball in the top right does two jobs at once: every hit adds to your end-of-ball bonus and every hit during multiball pushes the jackpot value up. It is the cheapest points on the machine and most players ignore it.

steps.detail: Each strike sends it bouncing through a bumper and several switches in its own pocket, so one shot registers several times.

steps.action: Do it before you start cashing jackpots
steps.detail: Building the value first is worth more than collecting a small jackpot early.

goals.title: The Coconut Trade-Off
goals.summary: Each coconut drop target adds a million to your end-of-ball bonus, but knocking any of them down converts the centre lane from a hole in one into a Gopher wheel spin. Decide which you are chasing before you start swinging.
goals.reward: 1M bonus per coconut, or wheel access

steps.detail: A million each on a bonus that also counts your holes and the captive ball.

steps.action: Or leave them for holes in one
steps.detail: The clean centre lane shot with all four standing is one of only three ways to bank a hole in one.

goals.title: The Storm Loop
goals.summary: Every big score on this machine comes from the same pattern. Start any multiball except the plain one, trap two balls on the right flipper, and loop the centre lane with the third. The catch-all flippers hold everything the volcano and the centre lane send back.

steps.detail: Hold the right flipper up as the balls arrive. This machine's flippers catch far more reliably than most.
The lane returns to you cleanly, so with practice this is a repeatable rhythm rather than a gamble.
Storm totals pay at the end of the ball. A tilt during a good storm costs you the whole game.

achievements.title: Off The Tee
achievements.desc: Land the plunge skill shot for a hole in one.

achievements.title: The Front Nine
achievements.desc: Play all nine holes in order for the first time.

achievements.title: Sliced It
achievements.desc: Spell SLICE and cash the fifty million hurry-up.

achievements.title: Found Him
achievements.desc: Find the gopher for thirty million.

achievements.title: Fifteen Seconds
achievements.desc: Collect the extra ball off the slice target before the mode expires.

achievements.title: Double Or Nothing
achievements.desc: Gamble Skins Game and make the shot the machine picks.

achievements.title: Three Hundred Million
achievements.desc: Clear down to the last jackpot in multiball and take the super.

achievements.title: Weather Warning
achievements.desc: Run Raining Cats And Dogs all the way to the end of the ball without tilting.

achievements.title: Go-Fore-Par-Tee
achievements.desc: Spell GOPHER on the roulette wheel and start its multiball.

achievements.title: Nine Holes In One
achievements.desc: Bank nine holes in one to light Quickpick at the Mean Hole.

achievements.title: Anything Goes
achievements.desc: Reach a fourth round of nine holes and start the fifty million storm.

drills.title: Skill Shot Hole Reps
drills.text: Time the plunge for the skill shot on every single ball, then catch what comes back rather than swinging at it. This is the cheapest hole on the machine and it feeds both the extra ball at seven holes in one and Quickpick at nine.

drills.title: Catch-All Flipper Traps
drills.text: Hold the flipper up as the ball comes back from the volcano and the centre lane and let these catch-alls do what they are famous for. Every large score here starts with a held ball, so make the trap automatic before you worry about where you are shooting.
drills.reps: one full ball, trapping every return

drills.title: Thread The Coconut Gap
drills.text: Shoot the centre lane through the gap in the coconut drops from a trapped ball, never off a live one. With all four coconuts still standing the same shot pays a hole in one, so learn the line while the reward is at its highest.

drills.title: Nine Holes In Order
drills.text: Volcano, right ramp, saucer — drill the rotation so you know which of the three owns the hole you are on without looking. Only the current hole gets spotted, so a shot at the wrong feature is a shot spent for nothing.

drills.title: Top Flipper Putt
drills.text: Take the right ramp up to the top flipper, let the post hold the ball, and putt into the Mean Hole from a dead stop. That walled-off pocket only opens to a lined-up shot, and a held ball on the top flipper is the highest-percentage look at it.

drills.title: Park Two, Loop With One
drills.text: In any storm multiball, catch two balls on the right flipper and run the centre lane over and over with the third. Keep your hands off the cabinet while you do it — the storm total only pays at the end of the ball, so a tilt costs you everything you banked.

actionButton.how: No button beyond the basics on this 1993 Gottlieb — two catch-all flippers, a manual plunger, and a small upper flipper fed by the right ramp. The catch-alls are the feature that actually matters: they hold nearly anything that comes back, and every huge score on this machine is built on trapping a ball and looping one shot.

howItPlays.objective: Tee'd Off plays as a round of golf: sink the nine holes in strict order, then farm the storm multiballs that each finished round unlocks. The catch-all flippers hold almost anything that returns, so every huge number here grows out of trapping the ball and looping one shot.
loop: Nine holes must fall in number order, and only three shots spot them: the volcano stands in for the 1st, 6th and 9th; the lone saucer for the 3rd, 5th and 7th; and the right ramp for 2, 4 and 8.
Finishing the ninth hands you a headline feature that grows each lap -- a plain multiball, then a Raining Cats And Dogs storm, a multiball again, then Anything Goes.
Between rounds, light the volcano to open the five golf modes; complete all five to light the big score target.
Bank holes-in-one from the outlanes, the skill shot and a clean centre lane toward an extra ball at seven and Quickpick at nine.
When a storm is up, park the spare balls on a flipper and repeat the centre lane for a fortune -- the total pays only when the ball drains, so protect it and never nudge hard.

lights.name: The Nine Holes
lights.lit: One hole is active at a time and only its spotting shot counts -- the lit shot is whichever of the volcano, right ramp or plain saucer covers the hole you are currently on. The round you are on carries forward rather than resetting each ball.
lights.then: Sink all nine in order and the ninth hole hands you a headline feature that steps up each lap -- a multiball, then the Raining Cats And Dogs storm, a multiball again, then Anything Goes -- before the cycle repeats.

lights.name: Golf Mode Start
lights.lit: The volcano glows for mode start whenever a golf mode is ready, and lighting it begins one of the five. On the opening lap the volcano relights itself for the next one; every lap after that it is the right ramp that switches mode start back on.
lights.then: Roll through all five -- Skins Game, Find The Gopher, an Extra Ball dash, the Tee'd Off centre-lane repeat and Pitch And Putt -- to light the big score target, after which no further mode can begin on that ball.

lights.name: Holes In One
lights.lit: Both outlanes stay lit for a hole in one all game, the Mean Hole pays one while its lamp is on, and a clean centre lane counts only with every coconut still standing. These add into a running total that climbs across the whole game, not merely the ball.
lights.then: Seven holes in one light an extra ball; reach nine and the Mean Hole lights Quickpick, a straight choice between lighting the Special and kicking off a lightning storm.

lights.name: S-L-I-C-E Target
lights.lit: Each hit on the lone Slice standup lights one more letter, and a letter already banked stays lit -- so only the ones still dark are left to finish the word.
lights.then: Complete S-L-I-C-E to light a fifty-million hurry-up, so know your angle back to this target before the last letter falls, because the value bleeds down the instant it starts. This same standup is where a lit extra ball is cashed.

lights.name: Coconut Drops & Gopher Wheel
lights.lit: With a coconut knocked down, the centre lane stops spotting a hole in one and instead spins the recessed Gopher wheel; a landed letter of GOPHER stays lit in its pockets while you chase the rest.
lights.then: Fill in GOPHER to kick off Go-Fore-Par-Tee. Its three balls turn both the volcano and that same centre lane into flat twenty-million shots, collected on contact with nothing to light first. Weigh it against the trade: dropping a coconut adds a million to your bonus but costs a clean hole-in-one route.

lights.name: Strobing Jackpots
lights.lit: During the plain multiball, jackpots strobe around the hook target, volcano, saucer and right ramp, and a strobing shot is a live jackpot near five million. Banging the caged captive ball in the top corner ratchets that value higher and pads your bonus at once.
lights.then: Grow the value on the captive ball first, then leave a single jackpot standing -- taking the last one pays a three-hundred-million super and relights the whole set for another lap.

scoring.text: Take the free stuff first. The plunge skill shot spots the cheapest hole in one there is, both outlanes are permanently lit for another, and the volcano opens the golf modes. Above all, lean on the catch-all flippers -- trap every return and set up rather than swinging blind.

Work the nine holes into their multiballs and clear the five golf modes for the big score target. Feed the captive ball whenever it is in reach -- it is the least demanding source of points here, and every hit quietly inflates the jackpots you will collect later.

The ceiling lives in the storm multiballs. Reach the fourth round of holes for Anything Goes at fifty million a shot, park the spare balls on a flipper, and loop the centre lane over and over. That total is paid only when the ball drains, so guard it and never nudge hard enough to tilt.
